title: How Does a Neural Network Learn?
objective: Explain the fundamental feedback loop of neural network learning — forward prediction, loss calculation, backpropagation, and gradient descent convergence — in an engaging, cinematic, portrait-native motion explainer.
audience: Technical developers, machine learning students, and curious viewers seeking an intuitive visual deconstruction of deep learning foundations.

message.core_message: A neural network learns through continuous closed-loop feedback: computing forward predictions, evaluating discrepancy (loss), and propagating gradient corrections backward to adapt synaptic weights.
key_points: Input features propagate through weighted synapses to produce a prediction
Discrepancy against ground truth defines scalar loss
Backpropagation computes error gradients with respect to every weight
Gradient descent iteratively drives loss to the global minimum

constraints: Respect mobile reel safe margins (10% top, 20% bottom)
Anti-Laziness Mandate: Continuous visual evolution every 2-3 seconds during speech
Editorial light canvas default: Warm ivory background with vibrant high-contrast accents

references.description: Neo-brutalist sticker explainer: dynamic diagram connectors and single stage progression
Paper-theatre silhouette poem in portrait format: vertical framing and depth layering

research.reason: Grounded in verified deep learning mathematics and validated research dossier in projects/benchmark-neural-network/research.json

creative_directions.name: Warm High-Contrast Editorial Machine Learning
creative_directions.concept: A sophisticated light-canvas scientific explainer where an ivory paper surface (#FBFBFA) stages a glowing neural network graph with vibrant electric ultramarine (#1E40AF) inputs, warm amber (#D97706) hidden nodes, coral vermilion (#E11D48) error gradients, and an emerald (#059669) descending loss basin.

visual_identity.palette: Ivory canvas (#FBFBFA), deep charcoal ink (#111827), electric ultramarine (#1E40AF), marigold amber (#D97706), coral vermilion (#E11D48), emerald (#059669), frosted white panels (rgba(255,255,255,0.92))
visual_identity.typography: Playfair Display / SF Pro Display headings, JetBrains Mono math notation and telemetry
visual_identity.texture: Subtle tactile paper grain, crisp frosted glass cards, and luminous vector nodes

signature_moves: Traveling signal pulses and marching dashed weights
Discrepancy delta bracket reveal and reverse backpropagation wave
Loss basin Catmull-Rom spline descent with live counter rolls
motion_language.transitions: Continuous single-stage progression with virtual camera drift and morphing focal anchors

composition.approach: Vertical 9:16 portrait layout with top chapter progress tracker, central hero neural graph stage, and bottom takeaway badge

creative_directions.pacing: Multi-beat evolution every 2 seconds synchronized with narration phonetics
creative_directions.why_it_fits: Delivers peak readability on mobile screens, eradicating the gloomy dark aesthetic of v1 and replacing static cards with an alive vector organism.

creative_directions.name: Swiss Modern Computational Blueprint
creative_directions.concept: A crisp, stark architectural visualization of deep learning math utilizing strict typography grids, geometric isometric node arrays, and monochrome graph coordinates with single-color telemetry highlights.

visual_identity.palette: Clean white (#FFFFFF), stark black (#000000), technical cyan (#0077EE)
visual_identity.typography: Helvetica Neue / Neue Haas Grotesk with tabular figures
visual_identity.texture: Clean geometric grid lines and blueprint coordinates

creative_directions.why_it_fits: Appeals to academic rigor but lacks the warm approachable kinetic energy required for mobile reels engagement.

selection_rationale: The warm high-contrast editorial direction creates maximum retention and visual joy on mobile feeds, blending rigorous scientific truth with tactile warmth and vivid multi-beat motion vitality.
success_criteria: Single-stage evolving neural network diagram occupying >= 65% of canvas
Zero static freezes exceeding 2 seconds while narration is active
All text strictly respects the portrait legibility floor (>= 24px)
Clean 5-gate automated QA pass and crisp contact sheets
